text:
Aria: spinning up nebula80k (int4v3) long-context bring-up. ctx=81920 prefill=76000. seeing a subtle "phase-echo" where 2-4 token snippets from ~75k reappear ~10-30 tokens after boundary. logs below.
Jules: repro command I ran:
```
./ignite_onboard --model nebula80k --quant int4v3 --context 81920 --prefill 76000 --kvcache-mode tiled --rope policy=per_tile
```
Ravi: symptom: stable until ~75.9k then intermittent emission like "... 6021 7132 6021 ...". not deterministic but high enough rate to worry (~9% runs).
Mina: sanitized trace:
```
[prefill] pos=75912
[kv] fetch shard=23 tile_idx=4294967290 offset=18446744073709551598
[rope] applied_phase=0.99992 expected_phase=1.00008
[decode] emitted: ... 6021 7132 6021 ...
```
Aria: offset reads like -98 in signed interpretation. that points to an unsigned wrap/cast leak in tiled index arithmetic.
Jules: bisect points to kernel v2.0 where we enabled "compact-tile-headers" and an optimistic tile_publish fastpath. good perf but possibly racy with eviction.
Ravi: perf note: tiled prefetch + per_tile rope gives ~12% p99 improvement. disabling compact headers restores stability but costs ~+7% p99.
Mina: quick hypothesis: optimistic publish can expose an aliased/stale tile when eviction races with commit; with per_tile RoPE the stale tile's phase differs and the model emits coherent micro-echoes rather than random noise.
Aria: quick mitigation tests: 1) enabling --prefill-snapshot=8192 removes incidents (mem hit), 2) disable optimistic publish (perf hit), 3) add a cheap 64-bit cookie validation on fetch (small perf hit ~+2%). 3 looks promising.
Jules: added a local patch that validates a 64-bit cookie and also bounds-checks offset <= current_prefill_pos + TILE_SZ. stress run: incidents dropped ~97%.
Ravi: CI: pushed svt/nebula-phase-echo with a 3-gold-longprompt set and an assert for "no repeated 3-token windows" for prefill range 74k..76k.
ci-bot: svt/nebula-phase-echo (pr/validate-cookie)  RUNNING 
Mina: quick log after patch shows rejection:
```
[kv] fetch shard=23 tile=7 cookie=0x1f2d3c expected=0x9a8b7c -> reject
[rope] skip stale tile
[decode] emitted: ... 6021 7133 7240 ... (no echo)
```
Jules: action items:
- Jules: open PR to land cookie-validate + cheap offset bound check + unit test simulating wrapped index.
- Ravi: run prefetch backoff sweep (prefetch=0/1/2) to quantify p99 vs repeat-rate and report by EOD.
- Mina: add 5 gold prompts that capture phase-echo to nightly goldset and create an alert if repeat-rate >0.5% over 100 runs.
- Aria: coordinate Dedicated canary note recommending cookie-validate opt-in for initial rollout.
ci-bot: svt/nebula-phase-echo (pr/validate-cookie)  PASS  checks=repeat-window-assert
Aria: nice work  will keep an eye on canary metrics. keep updates short here. :eyes:
